summary: The regex is replaced by a linear indexOf-based scan. It pairs quotes exactly as the old regex did, including the backtracking case where a literal never closes, and trims only trailing ordinary spaces. 500k random fuzz inputs over quotes, spaces, tabs, newlines and double quotes matched the original regex output exactly, and 15M-character literals (plain, space-only, unclosed, and dense with '' pairs) complete in tens of ms.
